description: Open a bounded XRPL WebSocket subscription and capture live events for the requested streams, accounts, proposed transactions, or order books. Use this when an agent needs event-driven updates instead of a one-time snapshot. The tool sends the native XRPL subscribe command, collects events for duration_seconds, then closes the connection and returns the subscription acknowledgement plus captured events. It is read-only: it does not submit transactions or modify ledger state. Default behavior subscribes to the ledger stream for 3 seconds. Do not request the admin-only peer_status stream unless the upstream XRPL server permits it.

accounts.description: Optional list of XRPL classic account addresses whose activity should be streamed.
accounts.title: Accounts

accounts_proposed.description: Optional list of XRPL accounts for proposed transaction events.
accounts_proposed.title: Accounts Proposed

books.description: Optional list of XRPL order-book subscription descriptors.
books.title: Books

duration_seconds.description: How many seconds the bounded WebSocket subscription remains open. Default is 3.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

max_events.description: Maximum number of events to capture before returning. Default is 25.
max_events.title: Max Events

streams.description: Optional XRPL stream names such as ledger or transactions.
streams.title: Streams

name: n9t2_xrpl_subscribe
